Gadofosveset is no longer marketed in the United States. Guidelines developed by North American professional organizations state that breastfeeding need not be disrupted after a nursing mother receives a gadolinium-containing contrast medium. However, because there is no published experience with gadofosveset during breastfeeding, other agents may be preferred, especially while nursing a newborn or preterm infant.
